prompt: List seven common kitchen tools, one per line. After each name add a few words on what it is for.

You are helping a small neighbourhood group plan a shared vegetable garden on an empty lot that measures ten metres by twenty metres. The lot gets full sun in the morning and shade from a tall wall in the late afternoon. There is one water tap in the north corner. Twelve households will take part, and three of them include a person who uses a wheelchair. The group has a small budget, so reused materials are preferred. Winters are mild and summers are dry. Write a plan with these parts, in this order. First, a layout that says where the beds, the paths, the compost area and a small tool shed go, with a reason for each choice. Second, a list of ten crops suited to the conditions, with the month to plant each one. Third, a watering schedule for the dry months that uses the single tap fairly. Fourth, a short set of rules for sharing the work, written so that a new household can read it in one minute. Keep each part under one hundred and fifty words and use plain language.
At sea level, at what temperature in degrees Celsius does water boil? Answer in one sentence.
